records.subject: Asymmetric NaCl doping of PVDF-HFP/EMIM:Cl ionogels
records.quote: This study demonstrates significant improvements in the thermopower of ionogels composed of poly(vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) (PVDF-HFP) and 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium chloride (EMIM:Cl) through the asymmetric doping of sodium chloride (NaCl).
context_quotes: This improvement results from the coupling of the preintroduced ion concentration difference and temperature difference, which reduces the cation migration barrier in the direction of thermal diffusion, leading to significantly enhanced performance compared to symmetric doping.
